integrity: The proof identifies all admissible extrema analytically and explicitly treats the uninformative and deterministic-bit boundaries. Supplementary numerical checks are not used as global certificates. Public literature priority remains subject to further comparison.
scientific_limitations: Known symmetric rate and known +1 start; one nonadaptive noisy sign measurement, independent symmetric bit flips, squared-error loss. No result for unequal rates, adaptive sensing, or multiple bits; independent novelty validation outstanding.
title: A singular noise boundary layer in one-bit telegraph-path quadrature
